claim: Lifting only the aggregator role to sonnet does NOT fix v3 detecting-insults' invalid-submission failure. Both X202 (haiku-everywhere, $3.80) and X209 (haiku-everywhere + sonnet aggregator, $3.98) produced submission.csv files missing the 'Comment' column, which the mlebench grader rejects with 'Submission should have an Comment column'. The schema gate for v3 detecting-insults is therefore NOT aggregator.

X209.error: Submission should have an Comment column
